notes.title: Version 1.1 is live - new movement option
notes.notes:
I've added a new option for moving around the Chunky Orbits sim. It's very similar to classic first person shooter controls. You can move with the left touchpad or thumbstick, and rotate with the right. Modify your direction by pointing your left hand. Press in on the pad/stick to move faster.

I still like the funky 'accordion' style movement from previous versions, but several users have requested something a little more familiar.  You can use either method, they are both available at all times. 

Other changes include some small adjustments to the main menu and an update to Unity engine v 5.6. See the ChangeLog for the full list. 

Thanks to everyone who's supporting my indie dev efforts by buying my stuff! Please let me know if I broke anything. ːcsdsmileː

notes.title: Version 1.0 is released
notes.notes:
Chunky Orbits is out of Early Access and released as v1.0! 

ːchunksːːchunksː ːcsdsmileː ːchunksːːchunksː

Active development is done for now, though of course I will fix any bugs that might pop up. I'll likely tinker with it and add a few things over time, but my main focus is now on my next project - XenoFarm. 

Thanks for all the great feedback and suggestions during Early Access! Great experience for me to go through the process of early release, interacting with players, gathering feedback, and releasing the final product.

notes.title: Small update with minor fixes
notes.notes:
Posted a small update to Chunky Orbits today. Just a few small fixes as I get ready to exit Early Access.

 Added sound effects when you delete a chunk and when a white dwarf consumes one.
 Fixed help text on left controller after deleting a chunk.
 Rebooting with the group of rocks now produces a few more rocks that are moving a little faster.
 Asteroid belt now has some torque added to each individual chunk. 
 Fixed incorrect particles size on Absorber menu item when scaling up/down.

notes.title: Small update posted
notes.notes:
Made a small update to Chunky Orbits today to fix a problem. The gamepad version of the sim was not launching properly if there were no tracked controllers present. Should be working now.  Kind of a hacky fix but I'll figure out a proper way to accomplish what I need soon. 

I also replaced the green direction arrow with some fancy particles that indicate the direction you'll go with the 'pinch and pull' movement.

notes.title: Small update with better performance
notes.notes:
I posted a small update to Chunky orbits tonight. 

Improved performance. I optimized the main game loop that caclulates the gravitational forces. It's now twice as fast and more consistant across all rendered frames. Should provide a smoother experience and allow you to add more rocks to the scene before performace decreases. On my system I can get nearly 300 chunks going before I start to see frame drops. 
Fixed the texture on the Vive wand on the title screen. Wrong button was highlighted. ːsteamfacepalmː
New Universe starts with 100 rocks instead of 42. Soon you'll be able to choose what to spawn when you reboot your Universe. 


That's all for now. Bigger update coming on Monday, the 31st.
